title: Very sharp , the larger knife is serrated, cuts bread etc.  good.
text:
Very sharp , the larger knife is serrated, cuts bread etc. good.. This Farberware set comes with two resin / ceramic knifes, and a Two covers for each knife.
The smaller knife blade is 3.5 inches, the whole length with handle is about 7 1/2 inches. With out the cover.
The larger knife blade is serrated 5.5 inches, the length with handle is about 9 1/2 inches. With out the cover.
These two knifes are very sharp, and ceramic / resin knifes stay sharp for a long time if you do not abuse it.
The covers for the knifes keep them safe in the drawer from cutting anyone.

Farberware has been selling cookware since 1900, and at that time it was made in the Usa.
In 1997 it was bought out by Meyer Corporation, and then became made in china.

These are Plastic handles, do Not put in your dishwasher. Hand wash only...That said, I only hand wash all my knifes, keeps the blade sharper, And my good knifes last forever. Also wood never goes in the dishwasher.

This is a inexpensive set, but should last for a long time , and ceramic knifes stay sharp for a long time before they need to be sharpened.
Do not cut on tile, or granite etc. use only wood or a plastic board for cutting, or you can break/ chip these knifes.
